name: American Plastic Molds
description: American Plastic Molds is a plastic injection molding business in Pompano Beach, Florida, that has operated locally for more than 50 years. Its services cover plastic injection molding, mold production, part development, ultrasonic welding, and repair and maintenance of plastic molds, and it also uses 3D printing in its work. The company produces plastic parts for industrial, medical, construction and automotive applications, from prototypes through full production runs, and serves customers in Broward, Palm Beach and Miami-Dade counties.

name: Amtech Systems, Llc
description: Founded in 1998, Entrepix, Inc. has become the most recognized independent provider of chemical mechanical polishing (CMP)technology. An early pioneer of the refurbished equipment market, Entrepix subsequently launched the first CMP outsourcing service, through which it developed and now operates the world’s largest CMP technology portfolio. Today Entrepix is the OEM for new OnTrak cleaners and has heavily invested in engineering and fabrication resources to design, develop, and manufacture upgrades, obsolescence solutions, sub-assemblies, and complete electro-mechanical systems for CMP-style polishing and cleaning as well as aerospace defense contracting. Entrepix proudly serves a long and growing lis tof customers that includes many of the world’s most prominent IC fabricators,OEMs, materials suppliers, and defense contractors.

name: Amy Food Inc
description: Amy Food Inc. is a family-owned food producer based in Houston, Texas, focused on frozen Asian-style appetizers. Its product line covers potsticker dumplings, egg rolls, crab rangoon, cream cheese wontons, empanadas and broth, with several items sold under the Jamy's Three Dragon label. The company produces its own egg roll wrappers in-house. Products come in pork, chicken and vegetable varieties and are offered to foodservice and retail customers. Items are shipped frozen and can be baked, deep fried, air fried or pan seared depending on the product.
